brief: 13.9c-47 round physics + lethality (balance task dropped by owner ruling: report only)

diagnosis.cause: Machine infantry-sized units (g7_m_packhunter 380 hp, m_captain 220, m_stalker_synth 450, m_scout_crawler 110, m_assimilator 900 ...) all carry armor 'light'; weapons.json armor_mult small_arms/light = 0.25 (sniper/assault similar). A rifle hit (9) did 2.25 hp. Hits to kill with a rifle: packhunter 169, stalker 200, captain 98, scout crawler 49; Sentinel rotary 190 on a packhunter; engineer pistol 380. No regeneration seen (20 s regen probe 0 hp; 5-min live LP run healed=0), no stage/difficulty hp multiplier on Machine units (only lp_world 'mech' secret hp_mult 3 for one human mech). g7_m_burrower armor 'medium' is not in the armour table (mult 1.0).
diagnosis.live_evidence: LP make_config(77) duel (full combat pipeline, .plan/lethal8_before.txt): rifleman vs g7_m_packhunter @5 tiles: 60 s, 60 shots, 46 hits, 0/3 killed. Humans also slow: rifleman vs rifleman 7-10 hits (rifle 9 dmg vs 100 hp).

round_model: DONE. sim/systems/ballistics8.gd + content/g7/rules_g8_rounds.json (rules.rounds8, PROVISIONAL). 27 round classes (v0, mass_g, k velocity loss/m, pen mm RHA, wound share of a body, kill share of vehicle design hp, chem, nofall); weapon_round + class_round maps (null = old path: flame, melee, demolition, EMP/arc/microwave, AA missiles, nets, torpedoes, AT mines). Armour classes none/soft/plate/nanite_frame/nanite_heavy (bodies, per hit zone or avg; blunt) and light_veh/heavy_veh/superheavy (t, blocked, kill_mult). 40 m per tile ballistic scale. Body dmg = wound x v/v0 x design_hp/squad x armour pass x mods (mods = s.damage / weapon damage: every Combat multiplier incl. splash falloff carries). Vehicle dmg = lerp(old x blocked, max(old, kill x kill_mult x design_hp x armor_facing x mods), pass); armor_facing ratio kept exact (G2 contract). Zone soldiers: Damage picks the zone first (Wounds.pick_zone, same rng draw count) so the zone's armour applies; head roll / KO / unconscious unchanged in Wounds. Wired in Damage.apply_hit only (direct + Combat splash); Damage.wound_hit (BLAST8 shrapnel) untouched. Pure / deterministic, no new saved state. Env LETHAL8_OFF=1 = old path for A/B only.
